title: My Tho in a day
summary: Hủ tiếu, Chùa Vĩnh Tràng, and the statue in vườn hoa Lạc Hồng. The pagoda visit is 120 minutes. Thới Sơn is the morning boat, on its own page. The time on the islet and the boat fare are Check on arrival.
